newsitem.title: INDIA: India to host global petroleum conference.
newsitem.headline: India to host global petroleum conference.

text.p: India will host a global conference on petroleum later this week, its organisers said on Monday.
Delegates from more than 30 countries will participate in PETROTECH-97 from January 9 to 12 in the Indian capital.
Representatives from leading Indian and international oil companies will attend the conference which is being organised by the state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd.

"PETROTECH-97 shall be a show window of the latest technology in equipment and services available worldwide, both in upstream and downstream petroleum sector," said a statement issued by the organisers.
